balls.text: Holes out to long-on last ball. Slot ball outside off, but Rashid can't clear the outfielder. Rashid clears his front leg and hits it in the air. Gaikwad makes no mistake
back of a length and slings in at the top of off, Hardik may have managed an inside edge onto the pad. Given leg bye
slower ball wide of off, Rashid swings and misses. GT sneak in a leg-bye

Sai has been given out lbw. This looks out. He goes for a review. Just short of a yorker length and slings in to ping the front pad just above the boot. Struck in front of middle. The tracker returns three reads. Sai has to go. Nevertheless, this was a sublime innings. The incoming Tewatia Rashid taps his gloves

This is a special player. This is Chennai's Sai Sudharsan teeing off against CSK. Mighty full on off stump, Sai drops down to one knee and slog-sweeps it over long-on. Hardik loves it. Ahmedabad loves it. Hardik walks up to Sai and hugs him
Launched over extra-cover for six more. 146.4ks full and wide outside off, Sai reaches out for the ball, opens the face and carts it over the covers once again
Clears long-on for another six. 141ks, Deshpande misses the yorker once again, comes out as a full-toss, lofted over long-on
heavy-length delivery outside off, skids onto Sai, who stays deep in the crease and hauls it to deep midwicket
pitched-up delivery outside off, 145ks, the yorker goes wrong. Sai holds his shape and belts it away straight of long-on
off-stump yorker, Deshpande gets it right, jammed to deep third
full-toss outside off, Deshpande misses the yorker and gets away as Hardik swings too hard and misses
Deshpande misses the wide yorker. Serves up a wide half-volley. Hardik doesn't need any second invitations. He lays into Deshpande and carts him over extra-cover for six
on-pace delivery short and wide of off, thrashed only as far as mid-off. Good over under pressure from Pathirana
full and wide of off, Hardik powers it away to the right of sweeper cover
short and wide of off, Pathirana hides it away from the reach of Hardik. Swished to mid-off for a single. They get another thanks to an overthrow from Chahar
low full-toss outside off, acceptable yorker, squeezed down to long-on
yorker on off stump, Sai drives it straight past Pathirana
wide yorker from round the stumps, 146.2ks, carved away to sweeper cover
off-stump yorker, jammed out to deep midwicket
Deshpande gets the yorker right, on the stumps, shuffles across and scoops it weakly to short fine
Deshpande goes for the wide yorker but misses it. Too full and wide of off, Sai reaches out for the ball and belts it away in the gap at cover. Even Hardik is impressed
This is even better from Sai! After having beaten mid-off to his right, he beats mid-off to his left. Special player. Back of a length and outside off, slapped away down the ground
Sai is turning up the tempo even further. Back of a length and outside off, Sai takes it on and slaps it away between extra-cover and mid-off
Sai shuffles across off for a scoop over short fine leg but instead he gets a leading edge, I think, over short third. The luck is with Sai as well
dug in short and outside off, left alone by Hardik
back of a length and outside off, helped away to deep third
fullish and on the stumps, whipped away towards mid-on where Theekshana fumbles and gives up four

full-toss wide of off, Sai latches onto his and scythes it away behind point for four more. Twenty-one-year-old Sai raises a half-century in an IPL final against CSK. Chennai's Sai is doing it against CSK. To quote R Ashwin: "This boy is going to go places"
very full and zipping through outside off, rushes Sai for pace and beats him outside off
very full on off stump, driven away just wide of mid-off as Hardik gets off the mark
shorter and on leg stump, Sai hangs back and plays it back to the bowler
Wow, Sai! Superb shot. Pushed through fuller on middle, bad length from Theekshana, Sai makes it look even worse. He drops down to one knee and launches a slog-sweep over midwicket
Sai uses his feet again and strokes it back to Theekshana who makes a half-stop in his followthrough
Sai muscles this full-toss over midwicket and turns up the tempo. 100ks full-toss, Theekshana loses his length, Sai punishes the spinner
down the track and drilled more or less straight to mid-off
darted across off on a hard length, chopped off the back foot to point

Another slower ball, Dhoni settles underneath this skier. Saha has done his job for GT. Chahar takes pace off.  Legcutter from Chahar, Saha aims to manufacture pace and slog it over the leg side. He can only top-edge it behind to Dhoni. Time for another time-out in Ahmedabad
knuckle ball into the pitch, forces Sai to check his shot. Dinked into the covers
off-stump yorker, but only at 115ks, tapped down to long-on
back of a length and curving into off stump, whipped away through the midwicket region
just short of a good length and outside off, Chahar takes pace off the ball once again. Sai delays his drive and cracks it to sweeper cover
slower ball, floated in, drops it into the leg side and tears back for the second
forced past Jadeja for a single

Sai clears deep midwicket. TN's wunderkind is taking on CSK. Pushed through and turning into the pads, Sai drops down to one knee and muscles it over deep midwicket. Gaikwad, I think, aims to parry it back into play. No dice
speared fuller on the pads, tucked away to deep square leg
dropped shorter and breaks away outside off, Saha manufactures swinging room and carves it away in the air between short third and backward point. Saha notches up his fifty
Sai backs away, Jadeja chases him and keeps him to a single to square leg. Jadeja's a popgun firing darts
shortish and slid across off, slashed away off the back foot to sweeper cover by Sai
Pathirana pounds it on a heavy length and bangs it on the top of the stumps. Sai stands tall and forces it down to long-on
dug in shorter and angling across off stump, Sai leans back but does not connect with the ramp
Pathirana pounds it on a hard length and outside off, draws a thick outside edge that runs down to deep third
Pathirana attempts another slower ball and pushes it past the tramline. Off-side wide
back of a length and holds its line outside off, 148.3ks, Sai opens the face and eases a single to deep third
scythed away past deep third for four more. On a length and outside off, Sai reaches out for the ball and puts it away square of deep third who is finer
full-toss wide of off, Sai swishes and misses. Off-side wide
Sai gets going. Pitched-up delivery outside off, Sai stretches out and drives it beautifully past the right of mid-off
slid across off stump from left-arm around, Sai opens the face and dinks it to short third
shorter and into the pitch, 104ks, Saha makes room and slices it in the air but lands safely in front of deep cover
another slog-sweep from Sai, this is hauled away between deep midwicket and wide long-on
on a length and turning into leg stump, Sai responds with a slog-sweep and gets it to the right of Theekshana at long leg. He slides in the deep and saves a couple of runs for CSK
shorter and fired into the top of the stumps, jabbed away to deep cover by Saha
shorter and wider of off, Saha manufactures more room and carves a thick outside edge over Theekshana at short third. He can't cut it off
Saha uses his feet, meets a full-toss on the stumps, and hits it down to long-off
speared into the pitch, messes with Saha's timing. Spliced over midwicket but does not carry to the man in the deep
pushed through on the stumps, Sai drops down to one knee and hauls it over midwicket
speared into leg stump, Sai backs away and drills it straight to extra-cover
tossed up on off from over the wicket, pushed away to the left of Theekshana, down to long-off
pushed through on leg stump from round the stumps, nurdled away through square leg
flat and skidding across off stump from left-arm around, slapped on the back foot to sweeper cover
shorter and turns back into Sai who keeps back and works it to midwicket
tossed up on the pads, splices a sweep, does not carry to long leg
back of a length and turns into the hips, shovelled down to long-on by Sai
Saha backs away, Jadeja follows him and has him stabbing a single into the covers
shortish and on top of the stumps, 100ks, Saha backs away once again and chops it away behind point for four more
pushed through outside off, non-turner from Theekshana, hauled away to deep midwicket with a flat sweep
back of a length and flatter in trajectory, veering in from round the stumps, stabbed down to long-off on the back foot
back of a length and on middle and leg, played back to Theekshana
Saha backs away to this middle-stump delivery and slashes it away to sweeper cover
on the pads, worked away through square leg
pushed through on middle and leg, clipped away for a single

Has Jadeja got rid of Gill? Yes, indeed. Fast turn for Jadeja. Flatter and breaks away outside off, the fuller length draws Gill forward and the turn takes it past the outside edge. Dhoni collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. Bam! Gill can't drag his back leg in time as he loses his balance. CSK strike after the powerplay. 300 T20 dismissals for Dhoni in his 250th IPL game
another quick dart, Saha uses the inward angle and nudges it to midwicket, to the right of Jadeja. He collects the ball but can't nail a direct hit
Saha uses his feet and slices a thick outside edge but it does not carry to short third
fuller and on the pads, clipped down towards long-on

fuller and sliding into middle and leg, whipped away in front of square on the leg side. Gill dashes back for the second. Jadeja, too, fumbles. He does not gather the ball and breaks the bails without the ball
darted into the hips on a shorter length, tucked away towards long leg from the crease
Gill forays down the track once again, manufactures his own length - full-toss - and belts it to extra-cover
Gill now rolls out the hard, flat sweep and lifts it over square leg. Pushed through on middle, he shuffles across off, gets inside the line and places it away from the outfielder. One-bounce four
it's not easy to step out against Theekshana but Gill makes it look so very easy. He backs away, gets close to the pitch and hits it over mid-off
back of a length and breaks away outside off, might have been the carrom ball. Cracked away off the back foot. Conway slides across to his left from cover-point and fumbles, giving up four
Saha backs away and aims to manufacture some runs through the off side, but Theekshana gets it to skid off the deck and gets Saha to drag it down towards wide long-on
darted full and on middle and leg at 96ks, played back to Theekshana
on-pace shorter delivery from Chahar, Saha flaps a pull past midwicket

Saha expects Chahar to change his length and line. Shortish and wide of off, Saha jumps across off, delays his scoop and lifts it over short fine. Slower one from Chahar again but Saha manufactures enough pace for himself
just short of a good length and holds its line outside off, short-armed along the ground to deep midwicket
another slower ball from Chahar. 120.6ks slower variation on a back of a length and outside off. Gill delays his punch and then gets it away between point and short third
shortish and on the hips, Gill short-arms a double to deep square leg

Chahar drops another catch, this time off his own bowling. Slower one into the pitch, barely 120ks, Saha uses his feet, checks his shot, and hits it back to Chahar. He stretches his left hand in his followthrough but the ball bursts out. This was a tougher chance than the one he dropped at square leg in the second over
on the pads once again, another aerial flick but does not carry to Chahar at square leg

Jadeja effects a direct hit at the striker's end, but I think Gill is safe. Back of a length and nips back in at off, not enough room for Saha to free his arms, he chops it to short third. Jadeja swoops down on the ball and throws the stumps down but Gill is in comfortably. Saha gives him a thumbs-up
shorter and wider of off, 140.1ks, Gill opens the bat-face and manipulates a single to the off-side sweeper
Three successive fours for Gill. He stands up tall to this short ball outside off and crunnnnnnnnnches it with a high elbow between extra-cover and mid-off. Top shot from a top batter
fuller and on the pads, Gill brings his wrists into play once again. Picks it up and whips it in the air to the left of deep midwicket

short-armed away between midwicket and mid-on. That's his trademark stroke. Just short of a good length and outside off, put away in grand style. Deshpande bowls a slower one, but Gill manufactures pace for himself
slower ball into the pitch, Saha is through with the pull even before the ball arrives and wears it on his body
Saha shuffles across off, gets inside the line of this length ball on middle, drops it into the square-leg region for a double
Saha backs away and pumps it over extra-cover. Floated full and outside off, Saha manufactures swinging room and goes over the off side this time
clouted over midwicket for another boundary. Slightly back of a length and angling into off stump, angling into the swinging arc of Saha. He closes the bat-face and lifts it over the leg-side infield
rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and guides it to point
here comes Saha: down the track and whipped into the stands beyond midwicket. Saha shows intent and reaps reward
just short of a good length and outside off, forced down the ground to the right of mid-off
another hard-length delivery that zips through outside off. Gill slashes and misses

Deshpande produces a chance, but Chahar drops it at square leg. That's a sitter. Fullish and veering into the pads, Gill checks another flick and chips it in the air. Chahar does a David and shells it. Will Gill press on to punish Chahar and CSK?
hard-length delivery from Deshpande. Aims for the top of off stump. Saha hops, fends it to the covers, and gets across to the other end
good length and too straight in line, Gill shuffles across, checks his flick through midwicket
pitched up. Deshpande searches for swing but not much movement for him yet. Played back to Deshpande
back of a length and veering into off stump, Gill short-arms a single down to mid-on
full and swings back in at off stump, Saha covers for the inswing and pushes it to mid-on
shorter and ducking into off and middle, Gill camps back and jabs a single wide of mid-on
back of a length and angling into middle and leg, Chahar has Saha hopping and working a single to midwicket
wide of the crease, shorter and largely holds its line outside off. Slapped off the back foot but more or less straight to backward point
full, angling in at off, then swinging away a touch. Saha inches forward to pat it to the covers

Jadeja's done it! CSK have won their fifth IPL title! CSK's players run onto the field as one, but MS Dhoni remains in the dugout, eyes closed. An incredible final over from Mohit Sharma ends with two marginal errors. First, an error of length, ended up as a straight six. Then an error of line. Low full-toss, but it's on the pads, and Jadeja swings at it and gets enough bat on it to get it into the gap, fine of short fine leg. What a match. Shame it's been shortened by rain, but the finish has been worth everything that went before

SIX! You only have to miss the yorker by a few inches, and you disappear. Looks for the stump yorker, lands it slightly short of where he's aiming, and ends up offering a slot ball that Jadeja launches over long-on, clean and flat. Stunning
low full-toss slanting away from off stump, and again it's too low for any elevation. Goes down the ground, hits it on the bounce to long-off. Another single
low, unhittable full-toss on leg stump. Clears his front leg, and he tries to manufacture some sort of elevation but all he can do is hit it to long-on, on the bounce, for a single
another excellent blockhole ball, slanting across to off stump. This time Dube manages to jab it for a single down to long-off
perfect off-stump yorker, and all Dube can do is get his front leg out of the way and jam his bat down. Jabbed straight back to the bowler

full-toss, low full-toss, angling in towards off stump, and Jadeja completely mishits it. Looks to go over long-on, and ends up scooping it towards deep backward square leg. Noor runs in quickly off the rope and dives forward, but he can't reach the ball in time
length ball, angling in towards off stump, ends up a little cramped for room even though he clears his front leg. Drags a swipe to deep backward square leg off the inside half of his bat
in the blockhole, angling in towards off stump, clipped to the right of deep midwicket

another good short ball, ending up over Dube's back shoulder. Difficult to control the pull from there, and he ends up hitting it in the air, but lands it in the wide spaces between short fine and deep backward square leg
short, angling across to finish in the corridor. Thinks of the uppercut, decides against it in the end, hoping for a wide. It isn't a wide
full, angling in to finish just outside off, driven to long-off
full, slanting away from off stump, driven with an open face to the right of deep point

and he's gone first ball! He was out caught at extra-cover in Qualifer 1, and he's out caught at extra-cover in the final. Full, it's there to drive over extra-cover, but he doesn't get the elevation he wants, and the ball ends up in the safe hands of David Miller. What a moment

gone, but what a terrific little cameo to end his IPL career. Quick, hard length, on the stumps, and Rayudu, looking to go over long-on, ends up slicing the ball with his bat turning in his hand. No distance on it, and he pops back the simplest of return catches

terrific shot. Stunning. Back of a length outside off, and Rayudu sits on the back foot, deep in his crease, and launches it with a  straight bat over the long-off boundary, finishing with his bat following through over his left shoulder. Incredible
Four more, and Rayudu is finishing in style. Another error from Mohit. Full-toss outside off, and Rayudu lashes it to the right of the diving extra-cover fielder
trademark Rayudu shot. Mohit bowls a rare slot ball. It's a slower ball but it's the wrong length, and Rayudu steps leg side to create hitting room, and launches it high over long-off

six more. Dube has arrived alright. This is a legbreak straightening towards off stump, and again it's in Dube's hitting arc. Clears that front leg again, and hits this one higher but just as cleanly, all the way over long-on

finally, Dube finds some rhythm. Wrong'un, turning away from off stump, and it lands just a touch too full from Rashid. It's in Dube's arc, and he clears his front leg, keeps his head still, and hits it clean and flat over the straight long-on boundary
full now, too full to get underneath, driven along the ground to long-off
quick legbreak outside off, goes back and punches it back to the bowler
flat length ball straightening from an off-stumpish line. Looks to go over the top, but loses his shape and ends up dragging it to deep midwicket, all along the floor
short outside off, turns away further. Pulled along the ground to deep midwicket
quick length ball nipping in towards middle stump, and Rayudu gets forward for a punch to long-on

gone. Mohit's lack of pace gets another wicket. Back of a length, outside off, it's there for the slash over point in everry way except it's the back-of-the-hand slowie. Stops on Rahane, and he ends up punching it in the air and straight to the man at deep point
goes short and into the pitch, offcutter finishing chest high just outside off. Pulled along the ground to deep midwicket

slower ball slanting away from the left-hander and landing wide of off stump. Dube is in position for the big hit weeks before thre ball reaches him, and in the end he just lets the ball hit his bat, bewildered, and the ball loops over the bowler's head and lands roughly where he began his run-up
slower ball on the pads, clipped to the left of short fine leg. No pace to work with at all
back of a length, angling away from off stump, flat-batted along the ground to the right of long-on

four more! Similar shot, more of a kneeling pull than a proper sweep, and again he hits the wrong'un to the left of short fine. Deep backward square leg gives chase to his right and puts in a full-length dive, but it's in vain
wrong'un, turns down leg, and Rahane sinks onto his back knee quickly and sweeps it away to the left of short fine leg

Dube isn't in rhythm just yet. Quickish and fairly full, turning from leg stump towards his cleared front leg. Inside half of the bat as he looks to go big, and the ball lands well short of long-on, to his left

Clears his front leg to go over long-on, but Rashid fires this too full for that. Thick inside edge dribbles out into the square leg region, and there's no one in the circle there. Rashid gives chase himself, and the batters sneak a quick second run
steps out, and Rashid widens his line. Looks to hit over extra-cover, and gets a thick edge that loops up and lands to the right of short third
back of a length, straightens towards middle stump. Gets his front leg out of the way and muscles it along the ground to deep midwicket

quickish wrong'un, pitching outside leg, and Noor finishes with figures of 2-17 in three overs after Rahane misses the flick and gets hit on the pad. Superb bowling in difficult circumstances in a massive, massive game
fullish on off stump, clipped down to long-on

beats him with turn. Flat length ball fairly wide of off stump, and Dube was looking to make a bit of room and crash it over long-off, probably. Beats his outside edge, and Saha whips off the bails. He hasn't lifted his back foot or dragged it out, though
back of a length close to off stump. Looks to make room and cut, and gets a thick edge that rolls towards short third
back of a length, flat, straightens close to off stump, punched to long-off
length ball turning in from an off-stumpish line. Presses forward  and dabs into the off side to bring Dube on strike
full stock ball turns down the leg side, and Rahane, looking to flick, overbalances a little and leaves the crease, but Saha fumbles it. Missed stumping?
short now, gets up to chest height, pulled along the ground towards deep midwicket

is this the shot of the match? Half-volley on off stump, but how sweet was the timing? Just gets his front leg out of the way and extends his arms through a straight-bat drive to launch it effortlessly over the straight long-off boundary
full outside off, punched to extra-cover

walloped. Little slants this back-of-a-length ball across Rahane, finishing just outside off, and he just stands there and baseballs it over the midwicket boundary. Somewhere in between a horizontal-bat and a straight-bat shot
Now he goes short at Rahane, and he doesn't middle his pull at all. Checks his shot and picks up two, since the fielder has to run in a long way from deep midwicket
short, gets up to shoulder height over off stump. Pulled in the air, but lands dafely in front of Noor running to his right from deep square leg

Noor bags his second of the over. What an over. Back of a length, and this one turns away from Conway, and it stops on him as well. Lets out a yell of frustration after mishitting it straight down long-off's throat. Was probably looking to hit it over extra-cover off the back foot, not an easy shot to play at all
another wrong'un, ends up a long way down the leg side this time, eluding Conway's sweep

another wrong'un, pitching just short of driving length outside off. Looks to chip to long-off's right, I think, and it turns in and hits the inside half of the bat, and he ends up chipping to long-off's left
wrong'un, full and turning in from off stump, gets forward and clips to deep backward square leg

wrong'un, dangled across Gaikwad and pitching outside off before turning further away. Don't know if he picked it, and if he did he's been done in the air by some dip. Looks to go over long-on, ends up getting a top-edge that skews high in the air before Rashid settles under it at backward point
full on off stump, once again too full for elevation. Driven down to the left of long-on, and Gaikwad is interested in a second but Conway sends him back
tossed up on leg stump, gets forward to clip to long-on
shot! First post-powerplay boundary and it's a six. Not a genuine half-tracker, but it sits up nicely outside off for Conway to pull with conviction and clear the midwicket boundary

slower ball, fullish on off stump, makes a bit of room and drives to the right of Miller at extra-cover. Moves quickly to the ball and throws at the keeper's end, with no one backing up, and concedes an overthrow
back of a length, angling across to off stump, clears the front leg and pulls along the ground to deep midwicket
back of a length close to off stump, punched to extra-cover. Seemed to stop on him slightly

another short ball, gets up a little higher outside off, and Conway pulls into the gap to the right of Rashid at deep midwicket. He overruns the ball again, but turns around quickly and fields it casually with his left hand

short on off stump, Conway pulls and hits it in the air, but doesn't middle it and the ball lands safely in front of deep midwicket, where Rashid runs in from the boundary and to his right and overruns the nball a little
shortish wrong'un finishing on the pads. Swipes it to the right of short fine leg, where Josh Little makes a good diving stop
wrong'un, I think? Looped up wide outside off, and Conway snatches too eagerly at the cover drive. Ends up dragging it back to the bowler off the inside half of the bat
shortish wrong'un, turns down the leg side, beats the attempted pull
back of a length, straightens towards the top of off. Makes room and punches to the off-side sweeper
full outside off, too full to get underneath. Driven down to long-off, all along the ground
looks to make room and the wrong'un follows him, keeps a bit low too. Punched back to the bowler off the back foot
back of a length wide of off stump, reaches out and stabs to the right of deep backward point
just a touch short, legbreak turning away from off stump, and Gaikwad makes room for the square-cut and beats backward point diving to his right
bam. CSK are getting off to a great start here. Wrong'un from Rashid, on the fuller side, and he gets his front leg out of the way to manufacture room and launch it sweetly over mid-off
premeditates a sweep to a ball that's too short for the stroke, and he's beaten and smacked in the chest for his troubles. Picks up a leg bye, though
steps out to a ball turning from leg to middle and pushes inside-out towards cover

senses that he'll try and make room again and fires a quick legbreak at the pads. Misses the flick, and gets a leg bye into the off side. Lbw appeal is quickly aborted because it pitched outside leg, hit the pad outside leg, and was missing leg stump on a second set of imaginary stumps
shot! Makes room to a slightly short-of-length ball straightening towards off stump, and punches it brilliantly to find the gap to the left of backward point
length ball on the pads, clipped to deep backward square leg
length ball straightening towards the top of off stump. Stays leg side of the ball and manufactures a soft-hands single into the off side
past the edge! Back of a length in the corridor, and it nips away with extra bounce as Gaikwad looks to jab it away square without moving his feet
steps out, steps leg-side, and gets leg-side of a leg-stump ball to slice it to the right of deep backward point

four more. Superb wristwork on this occasion. Uses the round-the-wicket angle expertly, meets this length ball on an off-stumpish line and whips it behind square, in the air, beats deep backward square leg sprinting to his left
shot. Back of a length ball angling in to finish around fourth stump, and Conway presses forwarfd and swats it between mid-on and midwicket
shuffles out to this length ball finishing near the top of off stump. Opens his bat face to dab to the right of backward point for a quick single
delivers one on the pads now, and Conway just whips it away fine, too file for long leg to be able to cut it off. Just the kind of over CSK needed to get themselves going
back of a length slower ball, ends up down the leg side. Conway looks to swat it away off his hip and fails to connect
back of a length, nips back in towards off stump. Looks to dab into the point region with an open face, gets a thick inside edge into the backward square leg region
steps out again and Hardik shortens his length while following Conway's movement to the leg side. Defended into the mid-off region
first six of the innings, and it's a top shot from Conway. Steps out, steps away to the leg side to create room, and slices this ball, with the angle, over cover point and all the way for six
length ball angling across to finish close to off stump, gets forward and pushes to the left of point, who moves quickly to cut off the single

shot! That's not particularly short, and it only gets up to about thigh height, but Gaikwad swivels quickly on his back foot and pulls it along the floor, placing it a long way to the left of long leg
length ball outside off, presses forward and punches firmly to short extra-cover
fullish, angling into the pads, and there's some late movement away, off the pitch, as Gaikwad attempts the flick. Leading edge flies in the air and bounces down to the right of deep backward point
lovely shot to get CSK off the mark. Length ball again, a bit more width on this occasion, and Gaikwad presses forward before opening his bat face to ease the ball between point and backward point
length ball close to off stump, defended into the covers
full on off stump, a hint of away shape, good stride forward for a crisp push-drive to mid-off
